description: Source code for quantized tensor operations, including concatenation and related utilities, within the PyTorch library.

methods.name: is_cat_nhwc_fast_path
methods.description: Checks if the concatenation can be optimized for NHWC format.

methods.name: is_valid_quantization_scheme
methods.description: Validates if a tensor's quantization scheme is per-tensor affine or symmetric.

methods.name: all_inputs_sharing_qparams
methods.description: Checks if all input tensors share the same quantization parameters.

methods.name: quantized_cat_impl
methods.description: Performs quantized concatenation, possibly using fast path or dequantization.

methods.name: qcat
methods.description: Public interface for quantized concatenation with optional ReLU fusion.

methods.name: qcat_out
methods.description: Performs quantized concatenation and copies result into provided output tensor.

methods.name: cat_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Concatenates quantized tensors along a specified dimension.

methods.name: cat_out_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Concatenates quantized tensors into a provided output tensor.
